checks.evidence: The first generated test checks that the displayed position equals the reference plus the distance travelled (10.000 + 0.500). However, it does not set up the stored geographical position information whose reference balise group had not yet been passed when received, and it does not have the train pass that balise group and then travel beyond the offset. The key behaviour of the reference check, the reference location only becoming valid after the balise group is passed and the offset is travelled, is not verified.

invented: Specific values (Track Km 10.000, 500 m, Track Km 20.000) are used as test inputs without being stated in the requirement
The assumption that the OBU's internal distance counter is accurate and accessible is not drawn from the requirement
